newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU appeals for calm on Comoros islands.
newsitem.headline: OAU appeals for calm on Comoros islands.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) appealed on Monday for calm on the Indian Ocean Comoro Islands hit by an escalating secessionist revolt on Anjouan island.
OAU Secretary-General Salim Ahmed Salim said he would send a special envoy to the islands mandated to talk to both government and secessionists. He did not name the envoy.
"Any division can only cause further sufferings for the people of the Comoros and would not be in the short and long term interests of all the Comorian people," Salim said in a statement.
France on Monday rejected demands by Anjouan separatists to return to French colonial rule, saying any solution to the crisis should respect the archipelego's integrity.
At least two people including a gendarme were killed on Anjouan in clashes on July 14. Islanders say independence from France in 1975 has brought only poverty and unrest.
Anjouan's poverty contrasts with the comparative prosperity of adjoining Mayotte island, which voted in 1975 to remain French.
